svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 8.78k stars in total, about 1.11k a year earlier. mr boxington 529, aube 2040, fnox 2292, hk 1272, pitchfork 690, usage 1060, +6 more 895.
